name: Neko Zamurai
source:
Neko Zamurai is an adventure game in which the player controls a group of samurai cats in the medieval Japan. The characters are really well designed and they got japanese voice acting. The main character of the game Neko received an invitation to return to Edo and as soon as he come there he will have to face different kind of enemies and talk to different characters to advance in the adventure.

The game is divided in chapters and to advance in those chapters the player will have to visit different places of the town and talk to different characters. To move around the town the game uses a top view perspective. When the player reachs a location the game shows a close up of the characters and there the player can choose what to do (wait, make an action, talk, leave the place, etc.).

In some parts of the game the game uses a cinematic sequence for the action part and to clear that scene the player have to press a specific button in the right moment.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/N/SLPS-01543.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
Neko Zamurai是一款冒险游戏，玩家在中世纪的日本控制一群武士猫。角色设计得非常好，并且有日语配音。游戏的主角Neko收到了返回江户的邀请，一到那里他就必须面对不同类型的敌人并与不同的角色交谈以在冒险中前进。

游戏分为多个章节，为了在这些章节中前进，玩家必须访问城镇的不同地方并与不同的角色交谈。为了在城镇中移动，游戏使用俯视视角。当玩家到达某个位置时，游戏会显示角色的特写，玩家可以选择要做什么（等待、采取行动、说话、离开该地方等）。

在游戏的某些部分，游戏使用电影序列作为动作部分，并且为了清除该场景，玩家必须在正确的时刻按下特定按钮。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/N/SLPS-01543.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
